compatible_assumptions: Fixed finite degree,multiplicities allowed, standard H² coefficient norm; do not import norm-dependent exact formulas from equivalent Dirichlet-type norms.
conjectural_part: General coalescence-maximum statement for arbitrary m,M; no arithmetic transfer.
next_step: Prove or refute global root-configuration maximum, or derive sharper fixed-m constants through a valid symmetric gap decomposition.
counterexample_risks: Raw Laurent coefficients already negative for m3M2; coefficientwise positivity proof fails.

next_step: Independently review fractional cutoff interpolation and quantitative Gamma coefficient, then identify a real Möbius cancellation estimate sufficient for prescribed-window convergence.

claim: The first-kind logarithmic Mellin kernel Gamma(alpha+1)/(s^(alpha+1)zeta(s)) and second-kind arithmetic kernel Gamma(s)/(Gamma(1+tau+s)zeta(s)) both retain nonzero critical-zero pole coefficients but have different smoothing dependence.
verified_compatible_assumptions: Positive fixed real orders; absolutely convergent initial Mellin integrals; nontrivial zero rho has nonzero imaginary part so Gamma factors finite/nonzero.
established_part: Classical mean definitions and distinct kernels directly checked against primary source; Abelian method usable after the appropriate growth bound.
conjectural_part: No automatic quantitative uniformity as order varies.
next_step: Track growing-order Gamma and reciprocal-zeta estimates before any contour shift.
counterexample_risks: A mistaken identification of tau withalpha changes the residue and may invent a multiplicity ceiling.
tests: Primary visual equation comparison and exact Mellin interchange.

compatible_assumptions: epsilon_N>0,epsilon_N->0,epsilon_N logN->infty; fixed q>=1; prospective RH-conditional analysis; initial contour lies right of absolute convergence.
established_part: Exact initial-line contour and restricted pointwise logarithmic-weight expansion.
